senses.gloss:
Wrong,Ⓒa.ⒹanyAyya, aDarmya, nyAyavirudDa, ayaTAnyAya; oft. by ut-ku pr.; ‘w(rong) road’ vimArgaH, utpaTaH, kumArgaH.
Ⓑ
 2 ayukta, anu-cita, anupapanna, anarha.
Ⓑ
 3 BrAMta, miTyA, ayaTArTa, sadoza, vitaTa, asatya, anfta; ‘you are w(rong)’ miTyA-anftaM-BrAMtimUlakaM te vacaH; ‘this is not w(rong)’ nEza dozaH.
Ⓔs.ⒹanyAyaH, aDarmaH.
Ⓑ
 2 apakAraH, nikfti f., aparADaH.
Ⓑ
 3 BrAMti f., BramaH, ayATArTyaM, asatyatA.
Ⓑ
 4 dozaH; ‘in the w(rong)’ sadoza, BrAMta, BrAMtiyukta; ‘yourself are in the w(rong) here’ atra tavEva dozaH.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓni-apa-kf, vi-pra-kf, aparAD 4 P; (with gen. or loc.).
Ⓑ
 2 miTyAdozaM nikzip 6 P or nyas 4 P; ‘w(rong)-doer’ aparADin, apakArakaH.
Ⓝ[Wrong]ful,Ⓒa.ⒹanyAyya, duzwa.
Ⓝ[Wrong]fully,Ⓒadv.ⒹanyAyataH, anyAyena.
Ⓑ
 2 duzwatayA.
Ⓝ[Wrong]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹmiTyA, ayuktaM, anyaTA, avitaTaM.
Ⓑ
 2 anyAyataH, ayaTAnyAyaM, anyAyena, aDarmeRa; BrAMtyA, &c.
